items.evidence: The Compensation Committee selected year-over-year growth in our non-GAAP operating income as the financial performance metric for determining our NEOs' bonuses for fiscal 2022
The operational performance goals set forth in the PSOs are important drivers of Oracle's business.
Become the largest enterprise Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) company as measured by an independent third-party report
Attain $20 billion in non-GAAP total cloud revenues in a fiscal year
Attain $10 billion in non-GAAP total SaaS revenues in a fiscal year
Attain $10 billion in non-GAAP total Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS) and Infrastructure-as-a-Service (IaaS) revenues in a fiscal year
Attain non-GAAP SaaS gross margin of 80%
Maintain non-GAAP PaaS/IaaS gross margin of at least 30% for three of the eight fiscal years in the performance period
Increase Oracle's market capitalization from a baseline of $207 billion by
Oracle's average stock price for 30 calendar days must equal or exceed $80 in order for the tranche to be earned
